title: loop: ship dist/loop-ctl.cjs and re-path loop.md/mode.md/SKILL.md via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} — the flagship command is unexecutable on plugin installs (R2)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) HIGH finding R2 (F35, adversarially confirmed). commands/loop.md (:26,30,62,255), commands/mode.md (:50), and orchestrator-routing SKILL.md (:396,411,482) reference bare src/session-lock.js / src/operating-mode.js / src/loop-checkpoint.js / src/loop-auth.js paths that do not exist in a plugin-installed user project. Every other command resolves via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/*.cjs; no dist bundle exposes the loop helpers (scripts/build-plugin.mjs ENTRYPOINT_NAMES = 6 CLIs, none loop-related). Consequence chain for every plugin user: mode never flips to 'loop', so loopModeCloseGuard (src/close-guard.js:41) no-ops (Gate 1 unarmed), no advisory lock, no crash-resume checkpoints — the entire deterministic loop apparatus depends on model improvisation. Full context: synthesis §R2.
acceptance_criteria: A new dist/loop-ctl.cjs CLI exists, built by npm run build:plugin (added to ENTRYPOINT_NAMES and shipped-bin.json), exposing subcommands wrapping the existing modules: lock acquire/renew/release (session-lock with holder id + stalenessMs), get-mode/set-mode (operating-mode), checkpoint + resume-point (loop-checkpoint), and grant-unattended (loop-auth).

commands/loop.md, commands/mode.md, and BOTH orchestrator-routing SKILL.md copies invoke loop machinery exclusively via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/loop-ctl.cjs — zero bare src/ path references remain in command/skill docs (grep-verifiable).
Regression locks cover each subcommand's happy path plus at least one failure path (e.g. E_LOCK_HELD surfaces as a non-zero exit with the holder identity on stdout/stderr).
An e2e proves plugin-layout operation: invoking the built CLI with cwd set to a temp project (no framework src/) flips the mode and writes a checkpoint into THAT project's state/ bundle.
dist-parity gate passes with the new bundle set; stale bundle-count prose encountered in touched files is corrected.
